heading_en: Required Capital Ratio of the Underlying Assets Taking the Delinquency Rate into Account (K_{A})
summary_ja: K_Aを、K_SAと原資産プールの延滞率Wから算出する算式を定め、延滞状況を把握していない原資産が五パーセント以下の場合の特例算式を規定する。
summary_en: Defines K_A from K_SA and the delinquency rate W of the original asset pool, with a special sub-pool formula where original assets with untracked delinquency status are at most 5% of the underlying exposures.
paragraphs: The required capital ratio of the underlying assets taking the delinquency rate into account (K_{A}) referred to in the preceding two Articles shall be the value calculated by the following formula, using the required capital ratio of the underlying assets under the standardized approach (K_{SA}) calculated pursuant to the following Article and the delinquency rate (W) of the original asset pool calculated pursuant to Article 244. K_{A} = (1 - W) · K_{SA} + W · 0.5

In calculating K_{A} under the preceding paragraph, where part of the original asset pool includes original assets whose delinquency status is not tracked, K_{A} may be calculated by the following formula only when the ratio of the total amount of exposures of the original assets whose delinquency status is not tracked to the total amount of exposures of the underlying assets is 5% or less. In this case, the exposures of the underlying assets shall be divided into the portion relating to the original assets whose delinquency status is not tracked and the remaining portion, and K_{A} prescribed in the preceding paragraph and K_{SA} prescribed in the following Article shall each be calculated for the portion other than the portion relating to the original assets whose delinquency status is not tracked. {{F:p255i0}} EAD_{Subpool1}, EAD_{Subpool2}, EAD_{Total} and {{F:p255i1}} are as set out respectively below: EAD_{Subpool1} is the total amount of exposures of the underlying assets other than the portion relating to original assets whose delinquency status is not tracked; EAD_{Subpool2} is the total amount of exposures of the underlying assets relating to original assets whose delinquency status is not tracked; EAD_{Total} is the total amount of exposures of the underlying assets; {{F:p255i2}} is K_{A} calculated pursuant to the preceding paragraph for the portion of the exposures of the underlying assets other than the portion relating to original assets whose delinquency status is not tracked.
